summative_rubric.title: G3 Map It Move It — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against all 4 expectations.

rows.expectation_text: sort, construct, and identify cubes, prisms, pyramids, cylinders, and cones by comparing their faces, edges, vertices, and angles

levels.descriptor: Names 3-4 solids with prompts. Some counts correct.
Independently names all 5 solids and counts faces, edges, vertices.
Sorts by 2 attributes and explains relationships.

rows.expectation_text: compose and decompose various structures, and identify the two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional objects that these structures contain

levels.descriptor: Identifies 1-2 parts in a structure with prompts.
Independently composes structures and decomposes into named parts.

rows.expectation_text: identify congruent lengths, angles, and faces of three-dimensional objects by mentally and physically matching them, and determine if the objects are congruent

levels.descriptor: Says congruent for 'looks similar'. No size check.
Independently identifies congruent pairs by checking BOTH size and shape.

rows.expectation_text: give and follow multistep instructions involving movement from one location to another, including distances and half- and quarter-turns

levels.descriptor: Cannot follow steps + turns. Confuses turn types.
Independently gives and follows multistep movement with quarter and half turns.
Designs original 4+ step routes with multiple turns.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 = grade-level.

summative_task_script.title: Big Map Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 4 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Geometer certificates.
Stations 1-4 (6 min each): SORT, BUILD, MATCH, FOLLOW.
Station 1 SORT: name and count attributes for 4 solids. Evidence E1.1.
Station 2 BUILD: compose a 3-part structure. Evidence E1.2.
Station 3 MATCH: identify 3 congruent pairs. Evidence E1.3.
Station 4 FOLLOW: execute 2 multistep directions. Evidence E1.4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.

evidence_per_expectation.E1.4: Station 4 — follows multistep directions with turns.
